description: This Java class models a disbursement period within a loan schedule in the Apache Fineract project. It encapsulates details like disbursement date, principal amount, charges, and provides methods to convert to data transfer objects and manipulate charges.

classes.name: LoanScheduleModelDisbursementPeriod
classes.description: Represents a disbursement period in a loan schedule, providing details such as disbursement date, principal disbursed, and charges, with methods to convert to data objects and manipulate charges.

methods.name: disbursement
methods.description: Static factory method to create a disbursement period with specified date, principal, and charges.

methods.name: toData
methods.description: Converts this disbursement period into a data transfer object, encapsulating the relevant details.

methods.name: periodNumber
methods.description: Returns null, indicating this period does not have a numerical identifier.

methods.name: periodFromDate
methods.description: Returns null, indicating no specific start date for the period.

methods.name: periodDueDate
methods.description: Returns null, indicating no specific due date for the period.

methods.name: principalDue
methods.description: Returns null, as no principal is due in this context.

methods.name: interestDue
methods.description: Returns null, as interest due is not applicable here.

methods.name: feeChargesDue
methods.description: Returns null, indicating no fee charges due.

methods.name: penaltyChargesDue
methods.description: Returns null, indicating no penalty charges due.

methods.name: addLoanCharges
methods.description: Adds fee and penalty charges to the total charges due at disbursement.

methods.name: isRecalculatedInterestComponent
methods.description: Returns false, indicating this period does not involve recalculated interest.

methods.name: addPrincipalAmount
methods.description: Method stub that does nothing; no principal amount addition is handled here.

methods.name: addInterestAmount
methods.description: Method stub that does nothing; no interest amount addition is handled here.

methods.name: getLoanCompoundingDetails
methods.description: Returns null; no interest recalculation details are associated with this period.

methods.name: setEMIFixedSpecificToInstallmentTrue
methods.description: Marks this period as having fixed EMI specific to the installment.

methods.name: isEMIFixedSpecificToInstallment
methods.description: Returns whether this period is marked as EMI fixed specific to the installment.

methods.name: rescheduleInterestPortion
methods.description: Returns null; no rescheduling of interest is handled in this period.

methods.name: setRescheduleInterestPortion
methods.description: Method stub that does nothing; interest rescheduling is not applicable here.
